sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Foreign Market Feasibility Study and Regulatory Licensing Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Hybrid overlay: U.S.-influenced corporate and maritime law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 27 May 1991)
Panama–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 7 November 1985)
Panama–United Arab Emirates Double Taxation Agreement (in force)
Panama–South Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework), Decreto Ejecutivo No. 202 de 11 de octubre de 2017 (implementing regulations of Ley 23), Ley 70 de 31 de octubre de 2017 (Registro de Titulares de Beneficiarios de Personas Jurídicas, administered by the Dirección General de Registro de Titulares de Beneficiarios, DGRTB, within the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas), Ley 52 de 27 de octubre de 2016 (shareholder register and bearer-share transparency), Ley 254 de 10 de noviembre de 2021 (creation of the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales before the Dirección General de Ingresos, DGI), Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades), Ley 38 de 2000 (administrative procedure), and binding resolutions and circulars of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre (Name Clearance Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the destination state is an HCCH 1961 member; otherwise Consular Legalization through the Panamanian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Pacto Social y Estatutos de Sociedad Anónima (notarized Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Panamá following notarization; Consular Legalization for non-HCCH destination states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Acceptance Letter and Notarized Domicile Declaration (Aceptación del Residente Agente)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Panamanian resident agent law firm (abogado idóneo)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in Panama plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for submission to foreign regulators/banks

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copies of Passport and Proof-of-Address of each Director, Officer, and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of the country of origin or issuing consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, accompanied by notarized Spanish translation where required by Panamanian authorities

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory under Ley 23 de 2015 and UAF circulars: (i) PEP screening of all directors, officers, natural-person shareholders above 10% where identified, the resident agent, and any controlling persons against the UAF national PEP dataset, OFAC SDN/EO 13818 list, UN Security Council consolidated lists (1267/1988 and others), EU sanctions, and UK HMT sanctions; (ii) automated continuous screening tools (World-Check, Dow Jones, or equivalent) at onboarding with re-screening at minimum every 90 calendar days; (iii) enhanced due diligence, including source-of-funds evidence, for any beneficial owner linked to a high-risk jurisdiction or where payment rails involve third-party payment processors; (iv) suspicious transaction reporting to the UAF within 24 hours of detection where any PEP, sanctions, or terrorism-financing indicator is confirmed; (v) CDD records retained for a minimum of five years post-relationship under Exec. Decree 202/2017. UBO attribution for the DGI registry covers direct and indirect ownership chains at the 25% statutory threshold, while financial institutions commonly apply a 10% evidentiary threshold for control identification.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level_note: The DGRTB/DGI beneficial-owner registry is not public; access is restricted to Panamanian competent authorities (DGI, UAF, Public Prosecutor), financial supervisors, and foreign tax authorities under exchange-of-information instruments (CRS, EOIR, TIEA), with no public search functionality.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Oficina Virtual de Consulta de Nombres y Sociedades (Sistema en Línea del Registro Público de Panamá), https://www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: State doctrine under Ley 32 de 1927 and current Registro Público practice: the sociedad anónima must adopt a distinctive denomination containing an entity-type indicator such as 'Sociedad Anónima', 'S.A.', 'Corporación', 'Incorp.', 'Corp.', 'Limitada', or 'Ltd.'. Names are inscribed in Latin script; foreign-language names are accepted but indexed under an official transliteration and must not be phonetically or orthographically identical, or confusingly similar, to existing registered names. Hybrid names (foreign commercial phrase plus Spanish entity suffix) are permitted; Spanish-language versions are preferred for judicial service and official gazette purposes. A single application may reserve only one name; entities in the same group may file simultaneous applications for similar-name families.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco (requires prior authorization of the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá)
Seguros / Reaseguros / Aseguradora (requires insurance regulator authorization)
Fiduciario / Trust / Fideicomiso (requires specific licensing or authorization)
Fondo de Inversión / Mutual (requires Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores approval)
Licor / Cerveza / Bebidas Espirituosas (requires Junta de Licores approval)
Minero / Petrolero / Exploración y Explotación (requires Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias authorization)
Universidad / Escuela / Colegio (requires Ministerio de Educación authorization)
Hospital / Clínica / Sanatorio (requires Ministerio de Salud authorization)
Gobierno / Nacional / Oficial / Estatal (implies affiliation with the State, prohibited absent express statutory authority)
Abogado / Bufete / Notario (restricted to licensed attorneys; requires proof of the abogado idóneo status)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name does not bar immediate re-filing of a new name. Formal recourse: (1) within five (5) business days of the registry denial, file a 'recurso de reconsideración' with the Dirección General del Registro Público de Panamá; (2) if denied, a hierarchical 'recurso de apelación' may be lodged with the same authority within ten (10) business days under Ley 38 de 2000; (3) final judicial review lies before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia. The name clearance certificate is not extendable or transferable; expiration after thirty (30) days requires a completely new search and certificate at prevailing registry tariffs.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted as a mission-support arrangement (mail collection, communication address) only where a licensed resident agent under Ley 32 de 1927 maintains the statutory registered office, corporate books, and shareholder register in Panama. For an ISIC 7020 market-entry consultancy, full virtual operation is operationally tolerated by the Registro Público but creates exposure before the DGI regarding claimed local expenses, tax-residence certificates, and economic-substance challenges; a physical commercial address and a bank account with a licensed Panamanian bank remain the prudent standard where local invoicing or a 'domicilio fiscal' certificate is sought.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-Moderate: approximately 10% probability of an unannounced or short-notice documentary inspection by the UAF or DGI during the first 12 months for a low-risk consultancy; likelihood rises to approximately 30% where annual invoicing exceeds USD 150,000, the entity invoices related parties controlled by the same beneficial owner abroad, or the company applies for Panamanian tax-residence or territorial-tax benefit certificates. Unannounced physical on-site visits are rare for unlicensed consultancies but may occur in coordinated UAF/DGI enforcement sweeps.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and name clearance certificate (certificado de búsqueda de nombre)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (arancel oficial del Registro Público)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Pacto Social y Estatutos (Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws) for a standard S.A. with authorized capital of USD 10,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian corporate law firm (abogado idóneo)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for standard non-banking incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Law 32 of 1927 (Ley 32 de 1927) on Sociedades Anónimas, as amended; applicable formation, share capital, registered office, registered agent, board and officer provisions (Arts. 1–59); supplemented by Executive Decree 28 of 2016 (regulated agents) and Public Registry of Panama regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Department of Legal Entities (Departamento de Personas Jurídicas)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) or private instrument signed before a Notary and inscribed in the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital is fixed at a nominal amount, commonly US$10,000, and capital may be subscribed without escrow or deposit requirements. Subscribed shares must be recorded in the share register and may be paid in cash, property, or services; issuance of shares without full payment is permitted unless the articles state otherwise, but distributions must follow due solvency rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT the incorporation instrument filed with the Public Registry of Panama is ratified. RESOLVED, THAT the subscribed shares and paid-in capital stated in the corporate records are approved for issuance to the initial shareholders. RESOLVED, THAT the registered office at __________, Panama, is adopted as the statutory seat, and the registered agent is retained. RESOLVED, THAT [name] is appointed President, [name] is appointed Secretary, and [name] is appointed Treasurer, each with powers under Article 30 of Law 32 of 1927. RESOLVED, THAT the officers are authorized to open bank accounts and execute market-entry consultancy agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Name Reservation Module (through the Panamá Emprende online platform or Public Registry customer service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a request for three preferred corporate names in priority order. The registrar verifies that names are not identical or confusingly similar to existing registrations and that the name includes or is preceded by 'Sociedad Anónima' or ends with 'S.A.' or 'Corp.' as permitted. Pay the search/reservation fee and obtain the name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Valid passport or national ID of the applicant/incorporator
Notice of representation or power of attorney if filed through a registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an administrative objection before the Public Registry or reserve another available name; the incorporation dossier must be reworked only by changing the corporate denomination and obtaining a new reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of Panama (Notaría Pública) selected by the founders, or authorized registered agent using the express incorporation system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the company name, corporate purpose, domicile, authorized capital, share classes, restrictions, registered agent and registered office, initial directors, and officers. The incorporators or their legal representatives must appear before the notary to sign; the notary certifies the public deed and issues the first certified copy for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Passports or national IDs of the incorporators, directors, and officers
Details of the registered agent and registered office address
Draft by-laws / articles of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses or the deed contains defects, the parties execute a corrective amendment deed (aclaratoria) or resubmit a fresh deed; all corrections must be completed before Public Registry submission to avoid objections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Registry Inscription and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Department of Legal Entities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified copy of the notarized incorporation deed, the name reservation certificate, and proof of payment of the registration fee. The Public Registry examines legality and enters the company in the mercantile register, assigns the entity microfiche (Ficha) and inscription number. The certified certificate of inscription is issued upon completion.
required_dossiers: Notarized certified copy of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Name reservation certificate
Official receipt of state registration fee payment
Power of attorney or registered agent acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Public Registry issues a defect notice, correct the deed by notarial amendment and resubmit within the procedural term; the applicant may also file a reconsideration appeal with the Director or use the expedited refiling procedure for typographical errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas – online Tax Administration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, apply for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) for the newly formed entity. The application must state the company's legal address as the registered office and the economic activity code corresponding to management consultancy (ISIC 7020). Obtain the RUC certificate and associated taxpayer account, and register for monthly/annual income tax and ITBMS (VAT) obligations as applicable.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Public Registry inscription certificate
Power of attorney of the legal representative or agent
Passports of directors and final beneficial owner declarations (if required under due diligence)
RUC application official form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI rejects the RUC application, remedy the deficiency in the sworn information and resubmit; if a duplicate or conflicting RUC record exists, request its cancellation or merge before the DGI compliance unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of Panama, with subsequent registration of books in the Public Registry as required for commercial businesses
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and bind corporate books: shareholders register (Libro de Registro de Accionistas), minutes of shareholders' meetings, minutes of board of directors' meetings, and share transfer register. The books must be presented to a notary for protocolization and covered by a notarial certificate; afterwards the company may activate the books for recording share subscriptions and board resolutions.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Public Registry inscription
Draft corporate minutes and resolutions
Shareholder and share issue details
Notary protocolization fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books are rejected for incorrect binding or missing formalities, prepare new books or incorporate corrective pages; the notary attests the correction and the Public Registry accepts the re-submitted set.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License (Aviso de Operación) and Physical/Civil Defense Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Mayoralty of Panama (Alcaldía de Panamá) and Sistema Nacional de Protección Civil (SINAPROC); environmental determination by Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación with the municipal treasury and pay the municipal patent tax. A simple office consultancy does not require an industrial operating permit; the municipality will verify the physical premises. For any rented office space, obtain a copy of the lease, a fire safety inspection from SINAPROC, and, if applicable, an environmental registration certificate from MiAMBIENTE under the non-industrial service category. Display the operating license at the registered office.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Certified copy of incorporation and Public Registry inscription
Lease agreement or title deed for the registered office
Fire safety inspection request and clearance from SINAPROC
Environmental registration form (if requested by MiAMBIENTE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality does not issue the Aviso de Operación because of incomplete documentation or zoning noncompliance, correct the physical address, renew or amend the lease, obtain the missing fire/environmental clearance, and file a reconsideration petition before the Municipal Treasury with the full compliance file.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – General Directorate of Industries, together with the Municipal Mayoralty of Panama for the operating notice; no sectoral industrial license applies to ISIC 7020 consultancy activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Operating Notice) / Municipal Business License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE), Environmental Impact Assessment Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III / Environmental Registration – office-based management consultancy has no material environmental footprint; a full EIA is not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC-bearing emissions are generated. Office waste should be disposed through municipal collection; any incidental sanitary wastewater must connect to the municipal sewage system and comply with Panama's applicable water-quality and sanitation standards (Law 41 of 2007 and Executive Decree 123 of 2009).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: SINAPROC fire-safety inspection and certificate for the registered office; structural load and occupancy safety check by the building owner (if applicable); workplace clearance under MITRADEL occupational health and safety rules, including registration with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) employer registry.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas); transactional portal: Sede Electrónica at https://sede.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Appoint a licensed resident agent; register the Sociedad Anónima's public deed in the Registro Público and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; 2) File the Aviso de Operación (Municipal Business Notice) with the competent municipality; 3) Apply online through the DGI Sede Electrónica for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC), submitting the Registro Público certificate, the resident agent's certification, the registered by-laws and the municipal notice; 4) Receive the RUC certificate, which operates simultaneously as the income tax and ITBMS identification number; 5) Obtain from the Autoridad Nacional de Gobierno Digital (AIG) the PKI digital-signature certificate and activate the electronic invoicing taxpoint in the DGI Facturación Electrónica system; 6) Register the bank account and legal representative with DGI to complete the registration profile.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope (Panamanian-source income taxable at the 25% corporate rate; foreign-source market-entry consultancy fees are excluded from Panamanian income tax; no pass-through treatment)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid entity-reclassification election exists in Panamanian law. Available statutory elections: (i) simplified small-taxpayer regime (Ley 66 de 2019) where annual gross turnover does not exceed B/. 36,000; (ii) advance pricing agreement (APA) election with DGI for cross-border intra-group services; (iii) election to apply exclusive territorial-source treatment, documenting the foreign-source character of consulting income; (iv) election to pay the 10% dividend tax on Panamanian-source profits only (5% for registered or publicly traded shares); (v) election under Ley 41 de 2007 for multinational headquarters (SEM) treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — VAT-substitute sales tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis threshold: all persons habitually selling movable goods or rendering services in Panama must register for ITBMS from the first taxable supply. Small taxpayers with annual gross turnover not exceeding B/. 36,000 may elect the simplified regime, but RUC/ITBMS registration remains mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing through the DGI Facturación Electrónica platform. Every invoice must be transmitted in real time to the DGI authorization web service via a certified API (SOAP/REST) before delivery; DGI responds with a unique Número de Autorización (digital stamp) and a QR security code to be embedded in the electronic XML and printed purchase forms. Non-integrated invoicing invalidates the buyer's ITBMS input credit, triggers a per-invoice fine, and may suspend the issuer's electronic fiscal stamp.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (1) physical exports of goods evidenced by customs declarations, and (2) services performed for non-domiciled recipients where the services are used or economically exploited entirely outside Panama, including professional market-entry consultancy (Articles 66-68, Ley 14 de 2013; Código Fiscal). The consulting S.A. may invoice at 0% ITBMS when it retains: the foreign client's proof of non-domiciliation, the executed cross-border consulting agreement, delivery and performance records evidencing overseas utilization, and bank documents tracing the consideration from abroad. No prior refund is required for zero-rated services; input ITBM credits remain claimable through DGI Sede Electrónica refund procedures.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera / Formulario de Exportación)
Commercial invoice duly endorsed at 0% ITBMS
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill for physical goods; for consultancy services, the signed cross-border service agreement with deliverables and performance logs
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) issued by the receiving Panamanian bank
Foreign client tax identification or certificate of non-domiciliation (e.g., foreign VAT register extract or incorporation certificate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DGI recharacterizes a zero-rated export, it claws back the uncollected 7% ITBMS plus monthly default interest at the Banco Nacional lending-rate corridor, and applies late-payment surcharges. Fraudulent zero-rating claims are prosecuted as tax evasion under Articles 779-A et seq. of the Código Fiscal, attracting fines between 50% and 200% of the evaded tax, automatic denial of input credits, annulment of fiscal invoices, loss of the electronic stamp, and criminal imprisonment of up to five years for the legal representative or resident agent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Superintendency of Banks of Panama) acting as the principal banking and AML/CFT regulator; the Banco Nacional de Panamá functions as the government's fiscal agent and settlement bank. Panama has no formal central bank and no dedicated foreign exchange administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized, with the US dollar as legal tender and complete freedom of payment on both current and capital account. There are no exchange-control approvals for profit remittance, capital repatriation, or dividend distribution. The only potential hurdles are documentary (corporate board resolutions, beneficial ownership declaration under Law 23 of 2015) and standard bank KYC validation of source of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not impose any statutory surrender requirement, retention obligation, or mandatory conversion ratio on export proceeds; receipts may be held and used freely in USD.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: HIGH for cross-border payment execution via Wise B2B and comparable EC/EMI channels, provided such entities hold a valid money-transmitter or e-money license in a reputable jurisdiction. Legal constraints: an offshore EMI must not conduct deposit-taking or lending in Panama without a banking license; it may only transmit funds for a Panama-domiciled user if it registers as a money remittance service provider under Law 23 of 2015 and complies with Panama's AML/CFT regulatory framework. Therefore, Wise B2B is viable for making outward trade disbursements and receiving inward consultant fees, but it cannot serve as a primary bank account for holding capital.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permissible for licensed Panamanian banks if the Sociedad Anónima is represented by a registered Panamanian law firm or agent and the ultimate beneficial owners submit certified KYC packs. Physical appearance is not a blanket statutory mandate; however, most banks reserve the right to require a notarized video-interview, and certain institutions will require a physical visit of at least one director for non-resident-owned structures where the proposed account receives large volumes or is considered medium-risk. Expect an onboarding cycle of 7–12 business days once all legalized documents are submitted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Panamanian shell company with no visible economic substance or physical footprint in Panama
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: An authenticated corporate registry certificate (Ficha) evidencing incorporation; sworn affidavit of good standing; lease agreement for registered office or shared services arrangement with the registered agent; detailed commercial plan for overseas market-entry consultancy; brief history of the clients’ consulting mandates; and a certified copy of a valid passaport plus proof of address for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners speaking and directing from a high-risk jurisdiction or a jurisdiction appearing on FATF or EU blacklists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth narrative supported by audited financial statements or bank reference; certified tax-residence certificates from the home country; an external legal opinion confirming that the home-country audit trail proves the origin of funds; transactional heat-map of the consultancy's expected inbound and outbound flows; and a heightened monitoring agreement with the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or negative adverse-media hit on a director or beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A professional due-diligence report from a licensed screening provider; a notarized declaration stating the exact nature and extent of the PEP role; a board resolution restricting the PEP person from bank-signing authority if not logically required; and a demonstration that the stated consultancy fee profile is consistent with ordinary overseas expansion projects.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be routed as SWIFT MT103 wire transfers to the Panama-domiciled account of the Sociedad Anónima, with the reference line containing the legal entity name, the Panama tax ID (RUC), and the corporate registry 'Ficha' number. Banks will typically accept only transfers with a purpose code consistent with a capital contribution (e.g., 'CAPT' or 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION') and may require a covering board resolution and source-of-funds declaration for inflows above USD 25,000. For non-resident investors, the initial wire should be accompanied by a notarized certificate of the ultimate beneficial owner and a bank reference from the sending institution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails include SWIFT MT103 for operator payments and supplier disbursements; documentary letters of credit under UCP 600 issued via a major Panamanian bank's correspondent banking network in New York or Miami; and local payments through Panama's Public Payment System (Sistema de Pago del Gobierno) or same-bank transfers for domestic disbursements. All settlement ultimately occurs in USD, with final clearing through the Federal Reserve's Fedwire/CHIPS networks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-USD currency exposures contracted through a licensed international broker or Panamanian banking intermediary
Plain-vanilla forward contracts for USD/EUR or USD/JPY executed with a licensed commercial bank in Panama or its offshore correspondent
Cross-currency swaps under ISDA 1992 or 2002 Master Agreements, limited to commercial hedging of trade receivables or consulting fees, not for speculative purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax ('Tasa Única Anual') — payment and DGI good-standing certificate ('Paz y Salvo')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; collection enforced through the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 15 January; in the year of incorporation, first payment is due within 90 days of the issuance of the certificate of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Staggered surcharges of USD 50 plus 10% monthly interest (first month), USD 100 plus 10% (second month), and USD 300 plus 10% thereafter (maximum additional surcharge USD 450). Delinquent companies are placed on the public arrears list, cannot obtain the Paz y Salvo or certificates of good standing, and after two consecutive years of non-payment the Registro Público may initiate administrative strike-off and extinction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta ISR) — substantive or nil/zero-income filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — electronic tax filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end (calendar-year S.A.: by 31 March); DGI extensions in practice extend the window to late April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of USD 10 to USD 500 under Article 711 of the Fiscal Code, plus a 10% late-payment surcharge on tax due and 1% monthly interest. Repeated non-filing may trigger de officio DGI assessment, restriction on corporate certificates, and administrative penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return (Declaración Anual de Sustancia Económica)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) under Law 254 of 2019 and Executive Decree 380 of 2021 — electronic submission portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 5 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year taxpayer: by 31 May)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial DGI warning with a 30-day cure period; subsequent non-filing attracts graduated fines of USD 1,000–USD 5,000 for standard omissions and USD 5,000–USD 100,000 for materially false or incomplete information; penalties double for repeat violations within five years.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No general statutory audit applies to a private Panamanian S.A. Mandatory independent audit applies to: (i) issuers listed on the Bolsa de Valores de Panamá; (ii) licensed banks, insurers, reinsurers, trust companies, and collective investment vehicles; (iii) taxpayers specifically required by the DGI, generally where annual gross revenues exceed USD 3,000,000 or where records raise material tax risk; (iv) entities in public-interest regulated sectors. A passive overseas market-entry consulting S.A. holding no Panamanian-source income typically falls below all compulsory audit thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) for listed and public-interest entities; IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes) for the typical private S.A., accepted by the DGI and the Panamanian CPA profession. Accounting records must be kept at the statutory registered office in Spanish or English and be available for DGI inspection.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 53 of 2020 (SERFE electronic beneficial-ownership registry) and Law 254 of 2019, the legal representative must annually review and confirm the accuracy of beneficial-ownership data held by the resident agent and the DGI. Any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the share register and reported to the DGI within 30 days; until entry in the register, the transfer is not opposable to the company or third parties. The annual confirmation is evidenced by the resident agent's updated Register of Members and the annual economic substance declaration identifying shareholders and beneficial owners for relevant activities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registro de Accionistas) — maintained by the resident agent; registration entry is required for enforcement of voting and dividend rights
Register of Directors and Officers (Registro de Directores y Oficiales)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas) recording annual shareholder and board meetings or unanimous written consents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 800 per year (typical market range for resident agent, registered office, statutory register custody, and annual franchise tax coordination; standard quotation for a passive S.A. is USD 350 – USD 600)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (not statutorily required for a passive S.A. below DGI/regulatory thresholds); voluntary full CPA audit typically USD 1,500 – USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (marginal rate on taxable income exceeding B/. 50,000; 15% on the first B/. 50,000 of net taxable income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial-source exemption: foreign-source income, export services rendered to non-residents (including overseas market-entry advisory), and profits from activities performed and exploited outside Panama are exempt.
